summary: Complete testing of Task 5: Support Ticket System. Backend: 45/45 tests passed covering all support ticket CRUD, filtering, threaded replies, admin auto-status-change, and status management. Frontend: All UI components verified. Fixed a pre-existing build-breaking syntax error in Subscription.jsx (duplicate code lines 296-297) before frontend testing could run.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate lines 296-297 caused a build-breaking SyntaxError: 'Unexpected token (297:2)'. The purchasableAddons filter expression was duplicated. FIXED by this agent.

action_items: FIXED: Subscription.jsx syntax error (duplicate lines 296-297) already resolved by testing agent. Verify the fix is correct in production.
critical_code_review_comments: support.py: Route ordering is correct - /admin/support/tickets/stats (line 168) is defined BEFORE /admin/support/tickets/{ticket_id} (line 177), so FastAPI routing correctly resolves 'stats' as a literal path instead of a {ticket_id} parameter. No issue here.
support.py: No pagination metadata (hasMore, page) is returned. The list endpoints only return 'total' and 'tickets'. For scalability with many tickets, consider adding page/hasMore in future.
Subscription.jsx lines 293-297: Had duplicate code (purchasableAddons filter) causing build failure. This was a copy-paste error. Fixed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI components and integrations verified after Subscription.jsx fix)

subscription_jsx_syntax_error.root_cause: Copy-paste error during development. The purchasableAddons filter expression was written twice. The first instance was part of the proper ternary expression ending at line 295. Lines 296-297 were leftover duplicate code that formed an invalid expression outside of any assignment.
subscription_jsx_syntax_error.fix_applied: Removed duplicate lines 296-297 (duplicate arrow function and closing parenthesis from the purchasableAddons filter).
subscription_jsx_syntax_error.impact: Frontend was completely broken - no page could load due to the Webpack build failure.
